summary.text: Andrew Nelson is the Workers Party candidate for the Massachusetts House of Representatives, 2nd Bristol District, in the November 3, 2026 general election, running against incumbent Democrat James Hawkins.
In a Ballotpedia survey, he described himself as a representative of the Workers Party of Massachusetts and a constituent in Attleboro.

paragraphs.text: Andrew Nelson said in a Ballotpedia survey that the Workers Party of Massachusetts is a political organization of and for the working class, with goals that include establishing working-class political power and building a socialist economy.
He said he has helped organize and volunteered in Attleboro, including with the public schools and youth sports.
He named organization and direct action as the policy areas he cares most about.
